name: universal-ecommerce-product-scraper
title: Universal E-Commerce Product, Price & Stock Scraper (JSON-LD + OpenGraph)
description: Extracts normalized product data (title, SKU, brand, price, currency, availability, rating, review count, images, and variants) from Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, BigCommerce, and custom e-commerce stores using Schema.org Product JSON-LD, OpenGraph, and Microdata.
